notes: These are appearance classes, not permission to drive. Paved ground includes sidewalk; route boundaries and depth geometry are separate.
Water, vegetation, unpaved terrain and unknown predictions are not automatically free space.
CamVid is regrouped by complete source video to prevent train/validation/test sharing a video. Original split is retained in the manifest.
RUGD uses the complete-video split in Table I of its IROS 2019 paper.
RUGD bridge is conservatively treated as a structure; the annotation does not distinguish a drivable bridge deck from the structure.
